title: Venty Portable Vaporizer by Storz (taxes extra)
description:
ALL STORZ ARE REGULAR STOCK

The Venty features an adjustable airflow with a maximum of 20 litres/minute. Portable and highly efficient, the Venty takes only 20 seconds to heat up thanks to the newly designed convection and conduction mini-heater. Precisely adjust the temperature from 40°C to 210° on the device or via Bluetooth and experience the best of dry herb vaporizers in a conveniently small size.

Features:
– Adjustable airflow up to 20 litres/minute
– Fast heat-up of only 20 seconds!
– Features our newly designed convection & conduction mini-heater
– Precisely adjustable temperature from 40°C to 210° on the device
– USB-C charging including Supercharge function: 80% charge in 40 minutes*
– Bluetooth connectivity and Web App control
– Integrated Boost & Superboost Temperature for maximum convenience
– 2 high-power Lithium-Ion Batteries
– UL-certified

*This requires a +15V @ 3A power supply (#TV227-1)

What’s Included:
1 x Venty Vaporizer
1 x USB-C Cable
2 x Normal Screen (Small)
3 x Coarse Screen (Small)
2 x Cooling Unit Screen
2 x O-Rings
1 x Filling Chamber Tool
1 x Cleaning Brush
1 x Instructions for Use

Warranty Information
